title: Effigy in Red
description: A vertical totem rises against a flat vermilion ground, crowned by a photographic face fragment over a Giacometti-thin line figure. Gold compact discs anchor the upper corners; numbered fabric letters punctuate the margins.
composition: axial vertical totem on flat ground

title: Reliquary
description: A lace doily frames a yellow Latin cross flanked by black vertical bars, set on a dark ground beneath a violet wash. Silver compact discs are pinned at the cardinal points and along the lower edge like nail-heads.
composition: centered shrine on dark ground

title: Sortie
description: Two oversized gold compact discs sit in concentric black-and-white halos in the upper register; below, a top-down line drawing of a single-engine warplane is centered on a blue bullseye. A frieze of small scoring targets runs along the base, with vertical orange and black bands dividing the field.
composition: two-register: paired discs above, plane-on-target below

title: Alley, Magenta Figure
description: A narrow alley wall is dense with overlapping graffiti and tags in saturated red, turquoise, yellow and lime. A magenta-skinned figure in yellow sunglasses, painted in a Basquiat-meets-comic register, occupies the central wall above a parked motorbike.

composition: diagonal pair on metallic ground
description: Two top-down warplane line drawings drift across a silver foil ground, partially overlapping. A wooden chess king stands as a counterweight at lower left; silver compact discs anchor the upper corners and beaded fringes hang at the base.
title: Endgame

composition: diagonal plane axis with chess weight right
description: A pink vinyl record and a gold compact disc anchor a metallic field crossed by two top-down line-drawn warplanes set at angles. A wooden chess king stands at right; small target stickers, beaded threads and gold-foil scraps drift across the surface.
title: Squadron with Pink Vinyl
Procession
description: A strict vertical totem on a light ground: a small top-down warplane at the apex, then a row of seven gold and silver discs strung like a necklace, then a haloed gold disc at center, with a black-and-white photographic strip and a final disc at the base. Yellow vertical bands frame the procession.
composition: axial vertical totem on light ground
open upper field, dense lower frieze
description: A large top-down warplane line drawing fills the upper field on open white paper, flanked by yellow vertical bands. Below, a tight frieze of small objects — perforated dot rows, a gold honeycomb panel with a turquoise star, a football, two silver discs and a target.
title: Drafting Table

composition: diagonal plane crossover on metallic ground
description: Two top-down warplanes overlap diagonally on a textured gold-leaf and silver-foil ground, one ghosted with bullseye eyes. A wooden chess king holds the lower-left corner; gold and iridescent discs cluster in the corners over a faint scoring sheet.
title: Treasury

composition: axial totem on dotted ground, dense base pile
description: A central top-down warplane carries iridescent discs as wheels and propellers on a perforated pegboard ground. A dense pile of additional discs, target rings, ink splashes and torn map fragments crowds the base, framed above by yellow vertical ribbons.
title: Float

composition: diagonal cascade of discs over central plane
description: Three silver compact discs cascade down a gold-foil ground over a top-down line drawing of a single-engine warplane. Strips of red lettering and small game-target stickers line the upper edge; the surface is densely worked, with overlapping foils and crease marks.
title: Untitled (Three Discs Descending)

composition: central plane with disc constellation, target frieze base
description: A top-down warplane drawing presides over a dense field crossed by three iridescent compact discs and orange vertical bands. A frieze of numbered targets and small painted icons lines the lower register; red and black accents punctuate throughout.
title: Untitled (Iridescent Squadron)
Hieroglyph
description: An Egyptian wall-painting fragment of a seated deity is centered on a light ground, framed by yellow vertical bands and partially eclipsed by a top-down warplane drawing rising from below. Gold compact discs anchor the upper corners; sequins and target stickers cluster at the base.
composition: centered iconographic panel with framing bands

title: Disc Crucifix
description: A sculptural cross of iridescent compact discs is mounted at the upper left of a tall white-and-black backing panel. Tangled strings drip from the discs across the lower black field; the whole reads as a relic suspended on a wall.
composition: asymmetric cross at upper left, dripping strings below

title: Gold Cross
description: A vertical cross of patterned gold panels is studded with four gold compact discs, set against a red square on a black ground. The construction is glossed with reflective tape and reads as a small reliquary or icon.
composition: centered cross on red square, black ground
central plane on light field, dense base frieze
description: A top-down warplane line drawing dominates the upper field, with three silver compact discs anchoring the corners and lower edge. A central engine-or-target form glows with yellow rays; an American football and a football helmet sit in the lower base alongside a clipped color frieze.
title: Fuselage and Helmet
Untitled (Football and Vinyl)
description: A blue vinyl record sits at top alongside a silver compact disc and a large gold disc at center. The lower field is a dense pop strip of football trading cards, helmets, footballs and color blocks; pixelated patterns and grids fill the gaps.
composition: discs upper, sport-card frieze lower
vertical squadron with disc and target field
description: Multiple top-down warplane line drawings stack in a vertical formation against a field crowded with gold compact discs, red rocket-fin shapes and concentric target rings. Vertical orange and black bands divide the composition; printed numerals and tags pile at the base.
title: Formation

composition: left-aligned plane with disc and snapshot drift
description: A top-down warplane drifts down the left edge while three gold compact discs float across the field. A small grid of polaroid-style portraits and printed snapshots threads through the center, with target rings and red and yellow ribbons accenting the surface.
title: Untitled (Polaroid Drift)

composition: wide horizontal panorama, asymmetric weighting right
description: A horizontal panorama: a top-down warplane glides left of center over vertical color bands, while a single oversized gold compact disc anchors the far right. Polaroid snapshots, target rings and ladder forms cluster in the middle band.
title: Untitled (Plane and Disc, Wide)

composition: horizontal panorama with twin disc anchors
description: A horizontal panorama: an iridescent compact disc inside a red bullseye anchors the left, an iridescent disc with a black-and-white photographic head anchors the right. Between them, a graffitied middle ground with planes, a soccer ball and clipped color blocks.
title: Wide Score

composition: axial vertical with crown apex and target base
description: A stylized green crown caps the upper edge above a top-down warplane line drawing rising from a large concentric target at the base. Vertical orange bands cross the field; silver and gold compact discs anchor corners and an American football peeks from the lower frieze.
title: Crowned Plane

composition: central plane on stacked targets, axial symmetry
description: A large top-down warplane sits centered on stacked concentric target rings, framed above by a row of bullseye-circle eyes and patterned panels. Three gold discs anchor the corners; vertical red and orange bands frame the field, with snapshots and stickers in the lower margin.
title: Bombsight

composition: horizontal panorama, twin disc anchors with central target
description: A horizontal panorama: a top-down warplane drifts across a yellow-and-red striped field flanked by silver compact discs. Two Rolling Stones tongue logos appear at right above a small football; a concentric red bullseye sits at center.
title: Tongue and Plane
Cloud Garden
description: A pale blue and white field is loosely painted with a soft cloud or flower silhouette; four gold compact discs cluster at center as fruits or seeds. A small line-drawn warplane appears at the lower edge above hand-drawn grass strokes.
composition: soft painted ground with central disc cluster

title: Yellow Figure on Black Wall
description: A spray-painted yellow figure on a swirling magenta-and-orange spray cloud occupies a black graffitied wall. Turquoise tag lettering crosses the lower half; small white tags and dripping signatures fill the surrounding surface.

title: Untitled (Twin Planes)
description: Two top-down warplane drawings stack vertically on a gold-foil ground. Three gold compact discs anchor the upper field; a small linear bird and a band of sequined dots sit below the lower plane.
composition: vertical stack of plane pair on metallic ground

description: An installation photograph: a yellow gallery wall hung salon-style with a dense grid of small mixed-media works in the artist's signature vocabulary of footballs, targets, and concentric circles. Saturated reds, blacks and yellows dominate.
title: Installation View, Wall of Works
Installation View, Crowd
description: Wide installation photograph of a large white-ground mural densely covered in concentric circles, planes, footballs and target patterns. Three viewers stand in silhouette in the foreground, giving scale.

composition: diving plane upper, horizontal disc row lower
description: A blue-tinted top-down warplane drawing dives across the upper field, fragmenting as it descends. Three gold compact discs sit in a horizontal row across a pale grid below; small numbered icons and a fourth disc cluster at the lower edge.
title: Untitled (Diving Plane)

composition: diving plane upper, weeping figure lower
description: A side-view Stuka dive-bomber plunges from the upper edge over the partial blue text 'WATCH OUT.' Below, a cubist line-drawn weeping figure emerges from a target field, anchored by a silver compact disc at the lower left.
title: Stuka, Watch Out

composition: wide horizontal frieze, dense uniform pattern
description: A wide horizontal frieze packed with the artist's recurring vocabulary: yellow vertical bands, repeating bullseye targets, footballs, fragments of warplanes and dripping black ink. Reads as a stretched-out manifesto strip across the white ground.
title: Long Frieze

composition: horizontal panorama, twin disc targets framing center
description: A wide horizontal composition with two large iridescent compact discs in concentric black-and-white target rings flanking a central plane fragment and football. Vertical yellow and red bands punctuate the field; small chess and figure cutouts populate the lower edge.
title: Untitled (Twin Discs in Targets)

composition: horizontal triptych, framed central panel
description: A horizontal triptych of densely packed aviation collage: planes, targets, fragmented blueprints and color blocks. A central yellow panel frames a stenciled figure between two dense outer panels of warplanes and ink splashes.
title: Hangar

composition: horizontal diptych, twin plane-and-disc panels
description: A horizontal diptych: each panel centered on a top-down warplane drawing surrounded by gold compact discs and concentric target rings. Vertical color bands and small figural cutouts thread between the planes; black-and-white photo strips line the upper margins.
title: Untitled (Plane Diptych)

composition: horizontal panorama, all-over roundel field
description: A horizontal panorama: dense rows of red-white-and-blue concentric roundels carpet the field, with two top-down warplane drawings emerging at center and right. Silver compact discs and small clipped fragments scatter throughout.
title: Roundel Field
Snake on a Stairwell
description: A black exterior fire-escape stairwell hosts a large white-line snake mural with bared fangs sweeping diagonally across the wall. Air-conditioning units cluster at top; a small toast-character paste-up sits at the base beside a red trash bin.

title: Untitled (Football Frieze)
description: Wide horizontal collage: a row of bullseye targets and footballs runs across the lower margin while two top-down warplane drawings cross the upper field. Red, yellow and black accents punctuate the white ground.
composition: horizontal panorama, target-and-football base frieze

title: Resin and Rust
description: An asymmetric grid of four panels: two warm rust-brown resin squares on the left, a pale yellow square at lower right, and a cream square at upper right. Three gold compact discs are mounted as fasteners across the right panels.
composition: four-panel asymmetric grid

title: Roundel Procession
description: A vertical totem composition: a top-down warplane descends through a field saturated with red-blue-yellow concentric roundels. Yellow vertical bands frame the procession; a small framed snapshot and a football break the rhythm in the center.
composition: vertical procession on all-over roundel ground
asymmetric horizontal with framed inset left
description: A loosely composed horizontal field with a framed inset at left containing a top-down warplane and a pink football. Concentric roundels and small CDs scatter across the upper edge; a vertical right-side strip of stacked discs and stripes acts as a counterweight.
title: Untitled (Sketch, Pink Ball)
Inventory 10054
description: A central black panel holds stacked target rings, a scribbled pulley diagram and the inventory number '10054'. Footballs anchor the lower corners; small clipped photographs and figural cutouts cluster at the edges, with a yellow rays-and-sun motif at base center.
composition: central black panel with corner-football anchors
central helicopter on dense target field
description: A central helicopter line drawing crosses a field thick with concentric red-and-black target rings and yellow vertical bands. A wooden chess king stands at upper right; small color cutouts and pink ribbon accents dot the lower margin.
title: Untitled (Helicopter on Targets)
Cardboard Field
description: Quiet brown corrugated-cardboard field interrupted by a vivid orange rectangle at upper center and a turquoise football icon below. Small printed snapshots and two CDs anchor the lower edge; restrained palette unusual for the artist.
composition: muted cardboard field with orange focal block

title: Untitled (Target Field, Wide)
description: A horizontal field densely sown with concentric target rings of varying scale, sweeping spiral curves and red linear strokes. A blue-and-white striped fan radiates from the lower left; small clipped icons and CDs punctuate the surface.
composition: wide horizontal panorama, all-over target field
axial vertical totem with text band
description: A vertical totem composition: a small football-and-helmet panel above a top-down warplane drawing, framed by red-and-black target rings and the painted word 'WHAT'. A chess piece anchors the lower left; vertical color bands and a target frieze close the bottom.
title: Untitled (Plane Totem with Text)
Crown of Polaroids
description: A red Basquiat-style three-point crown caps a horizontal band of small color polaroids. Below, a large gold compact disc on a wagon-wheel halo and a smaller silver disc, with an American football and a small line-drawn warplane upper right.
composition: crown above polaroid band, disc and football below

title: Rhode, White Figure
description: A black exterior wall hosts a tall white painted nude figure pasted up beneath yellow spray-painted text reading 'RHODE'. A cartoon Mr. Snowmann tag sits at left; a wide-eyed character and small running figure are tagged at lower left.
composition: central pasted figure on dark wall
wide horizontal panorama, all-over dense field
description: A wide horizontal field densely packed with footballs, target rings and red-and-black vertical bands. Multiple bullseye eyes and small icons swarm across the surface; the rhythm is restless and saturated.
title: Untitled (Dense Field)
Dad, Two Footballs
description: A central framed inset shows a top-down warplane against a black ground with a red football. Around it, target rings, two more footballs and the hand-painted word 'DAD' at lower right; a yellow rectangle and small figural cutouts complete the surface.
composition: framed inset center, target satellites

title: Foil Cross
description: A horizontal mirror-foil panel hosts a vertical cross studded with gold compact discs, with discs scattered across the lower half. Red ribbon strips drip down the foil; small printed labels flank the left edge.
composition: central cross on horizontal foil ground
square dense field with text base
description: Densely packed square composition: top-down warplane drawings rise from a base inscribed 'GUERNICA', surrounded by footballs, target rings and silver compact discs. The signature war narrative compacted into a single saturated panel.
title: Guernica

composition: framed central plane on stacked targets
description: A framed central work: two gold compact discs at the upper edge sit above a top-down warplane drawing centered on stacked target rings. A frieze of small bullseye targets runs along the lower margin; orange and black accents punctuate the white field.
title: Untitled (Framed Plane on Targets)
Untitled (Two Boards)
description: Two stacked rectangular panels: the upper has a black chess king and music note, the lower a red-and-black 'PINTE' panel with chess pieces. Silver compact discs ring the outer edge; small icons and text scribbles fill the margins.
composition: two stacked panels on disc-edged ground
wide horizontal panorama, all-over target field
description: A wide horizontal field saturated with concentric target rings of varying scale. Two black skateboards anchor the lower edge; a red-bordered grid of game-board lines and small color icons crosses the upper field.
title: Untitled (Skateboards on Target Field)

composition: wide horizontal panorama, twin disc center
description: A wide horizontal collage with two large silver compact discs at center anchoring a yellow base panel inscribed 'XXIIIBUS'. Concentric target rings, scribbled diagrams and red and green vertical bands surround the central pair.
title: XXIII Bus

composition: horizontal trio of planes on muted ground
description: A muted yellow ground hosts three top-down warplane drawings arranged across the horizontal field. Concentric target rings ring the outer edges; small black-and-white photo strips and pale color washes thread between the planes.
title: Untitled (Three Planes, Yellow)

composition: grid of panels with repeated text
description: A grid of stacked panels, each carrying a top-down warplane drawing or target rings. The painted word 'OTHER' appears repeatedly across the columns; footballs and concentric circles fill the gaps between panels.
title: Untitled (Plane Grid, OTHER)
Occupy Democracy
description: A black wall beside a white Georgian door (no. 178A) hosts a tall yellow paste-up of a crowned figure with 'occupydemocracy' tags repeated alongside. Two small Mr. Snowmann tags and a stencil signature mark the door frame; a black-line owl mural sweeps across the lower right.
composition: central paste-up beside Georgian doorway

title: Guernica, Tall
description: A vertical totem composition titled 'GUERNICA' across the top: warplanes scatter from the upper edge over a central panel of fragmented faces and ruins, descending to a base of four black-and-white photographic strips and silver compact discs. Red ink dominates the upper register.
composition: axial vertical totem with text crown

title: Falling City
description: A vertical narrative on a white field: a turquoise warplane plunges from the upper edge over twin photographic faces, descending through a red flag panel to a base of black-and-white aerial-bombardment photographs of a ruined city.
composition: axial vertical totem, narrative descent

title: Guernica, Bomber Above
description: A two-color flag composition: a top-down four-engine bomber drawing crowns the cyan upper field above the painted word 'GUERNICA'; a red square below holds a black-and-white photograph of the bombed town under the green base inscribed with the same.
composition: two-register flag, bomber over destruction photograph

title: Foil Cross with Wires
description: A sculptural cross of crumpled silver foil studded with mismatched compact discs is mounted on a reflective foil ground. White wires drip down from the discs across the lower half; a small purple wing fragment hangs at center.
composition: central cross on foil ground with dripping wires

title: Untitled (Page on Bands)
description: A central white blank page, splattered with paint drips, is suspended on yellow vertical bands over a saturated field of red, blue and white concentric roundels. Two gold compact discs anchor the lower edge as wheels.
composition: central blank panel on roundel field, disc base
cassette-shaped panel with disc reels
description: A cassette-tape composition: yellow vertical bands occupy the upper rectangle, framed by black sides studded with cassette-spool icons; below, two large gold compact discs sit as cassette reels, with smaller discs spilling onto the lower edge.
title: Cassette
Untitled (Page on Targets)
description: A central pinned page with two silver compact discs and a hovering UFO-like form is framed by an outer field of red-and-black concentric target rings. A black chess king stands at lower left; smaller discs scatter at the base.
composition: central pinned page on target field

title: Untitled (Three Discs, Wide)
description: A wide horizontal field with three silver compact discs floating across the upper register and a row of bullseye targets along the base. Red and blue vertical bands at the right edge; small football and chess king cutouts punctuate the lower margin.
composition: wide horizontal panorama with disc trio

title: Untitled (Three Discs, Quiet)
description: A spare composition: three silver compact discs descend diagonally across a near-empty white field, with a tiny top-down warplane drawing at the base. Pinprick perforations line the left and right edges; a single red strip closes the bottom.
composition: diagonal disc descent on near-empty field
central twin planes with disc and ribbon field
description: Two horizontal warplane line drawings stack in the central register, surrounded by gold and silver compact discs and concentric rings. Pink, magenta and yellow ribbon stripes punctuate the field; a chess king stands at lower left and a bullseye anchors the base.
title: Untitled (Twin Planes with Discs)
Stencil Girl, Brick Wall
description: A black-and-white stencil of a young girl holding a doily-patterned object is sprayed on a weathered yellow brick wall. Two small Mr. Snowmann tags and a spray-can stencil mark the upper edge of the wall.
composition: central stencil on brick wall
empty centre with crowded perimeter
description: Crowded margins frame a near-empty central white panel: silver and gold compact discs, footballs, target rings, chess pieces and a soccer ball cluster densely along the four edges. The empty center reads as a pause within a busy field.
title: Untitled (White Frame, Crowded Margins)

composition: central inset with text tabs
description: Three gold compact discs anchor an inset white square at center, tagged with the painted words 'london' below and 'LIVERPOOL' on a yellow tab. A small line-drawn warplane, target rings and a black-and-white photographic strip frame the inset.
title: London, Liverpool
Untitled (Three Discs Above OTHER)
description: Three silver compact discs cluster in the central register over a base inscribed 'OTHER'. A small top-down warplane rises at the upper edge; a row of red-and-black bullseye targets and a magenta football line the lower frieze.
composition: central disc cluster with text base
open upper field, disc-and-target frieze base
description: Two top-down warplane drawings drift across the upper white field, one trailing a small cloud and red flag boxes; the painted word 'SURPRISE' marks the right edge. A horizontal row of gold compact discs and twin red bullseyes runs along the base. A wooden chess king stands at upper left.
title: Surprise
Cassette Altar
description: A vertical wall assemblage on a black ground: a row of empty cassette-tape cases at the top studded with iridescent compact discs, blue ribbon strips drip down to a central altar of crumpled silver foil and clustered discs. A computer keyboard fragment closes the base.
composition: vertical altar with cascading ribbons
central bomber on black ground, target base
description: On a black ground a single white-line top-down bomber drawing hovers central, with two silver compact discs flanking targets at the lower edge. A small white chess king floats at upper left; teal accent strips punctuate the right side.
title: Bomber, Black Ground

composition: central blank panel within bordered frame
description: A central blank white panel hosts a single top-down warplane drawing, framed in orange and ringed by the artist's vocabulary: target rings, additional planes, two gold compact discs at the lower edge, and pale yellow vertical drips down the surrounding margin.
title: Untitled (Plane on Empty Page)

composition: framed plane swarm with disc descent
description: A red-bordered frame holds a flock of top-down warplane drawings; three silver compact discs scale across the field. Vertical orange stripes drip down the white ground; a green X on a purple square anchors the centre, with target rings and a magenta football along the base. Inscribed 'XXIII DBS' lower right.
title: XXIII Discs

composition: axial squadron on black ground, target base
description: Negative-image variant: a black-ground panel hosts white-line top-down warplanes stacked vertically, framed by perforated borders and a base frieze of black-and-white concentric targets. Two silver compact discs sit in the lower margin.
title: Negative Squadron

composition: axial squadron on blue striped ground
description: Companion to the red-bordered XXIII piece, recast in cobalt blue: vertical blue stripes carry a flock of warplanes; iridescent and silver compact discs scatter across the upper field. Black-and-white target rings cluster at the base; inscribed 'XXIII DBS' lower right.
title: XXIII Discs, Blue
Star of David, Snowman
description: A street wall painted purple and red carries a Star of David containing a small white snowman on a red triangle, and a stylized rifle filling the upper triangle. Painted text fragments and ink drips frame the panel; an unmistakable Mr. Snowmann composition.
composition: central Star of David with figure
central football on near-empty field
description: A near-empty white field hosts a top-down warplane drawing at the upper centre and a large pasted American football mid-field. Concentric target rings cluster at the corners over black-and-white photographic strips and small icons.
title: Football Drift

composition: spare narrative drawing with text base
description: A spare drawing-as-greeting on white paper: a small fighter plane at upper centre approaches a large four-engine bomber at the base, with a circular trace and a target between them. Inscribed 'Merry Christmas 2013' along the lower margin.
title: Merry Christmas 2013
Football, Black Ground
description: On a near-black ground a single American football looms at centre, surrounded by small bullseye eyes, scattered photographic snapshots and a wide horizontal red line. Hot-pink accents flicker at the upper edge; a small line-drawn warplane at the right.
composition: central football on dark ground
spare narrative drawing on black ground
description: Companion to the white-ground Christmas piece, recast on a black ground: a small green-and-white fighter at the upper centre approaches a four-engine bomber at the base. Two gold compact discs hang in the upper field; a circular ghost trace centres the composition.
title: Merry Christmas 2013, Black

composition: yellow frame around blank centre, target columns
description: A yellow vertical frame holds a near-empty central white panel, ringed by columns of bullseye targets and gold compact discs. A line-drawn warplane crowns the upper edge; a wooden chess king at lower left, with a black-and-white photograph and small text strip at the base.
title: Yellow Frame, Blank Page
Tower Altar
description: A vertical wall altar on a black ground: an upper canopy of speakers and brown corrugated panels, a central crumpled silver-foil totem with red ribbon descents, and a base of stacked white-and-blue printed strips fringed with hanging cables.
composition: vertical altar with canopy, foil torso, base frieze
yellow frame with twin chess anchors
description: Variant of the yellow-frame composition with twin chess kings — one black at lower left, one white at lower right — flanking a central blank panel. Silver and red bullseye target rings line the columns; a top-down warplane drawing crowns the top edge.
title: Yellow Frame with Two Kings

composition: axial vertical with target columns flanking ruin inset
description: A dark-ground composition: a fighter at the upper centre and a four-engine bomber at the base flank a black inset of a ruined city skyline. Iridescent and pink target rings descend in vertical columns; a chess king at lower left.
title: Night Mission

composition: central red stage with twin planes above
description: A central red stage panel hosts a black-and-white photograph of an animal carcass and a small face below; two top-down warplane drawings hover above on purple drip columns. Black-and-white concentric targets cluster in the corners and along the lower edge.
title: Red Stage, Two Planes

composition: spare central field with disc cluster and green band
description: Three silver compact discs cluster across the lower half of a near-empty white field, with a fourth disc upper right. A single green vertical band drops from a maroon football panel at top; small target rings and CD fragments line the lower edge. A scribbled bicycle silhouette runs through the centre.
title: Football, Three Discs, Green Stripe
Sticker Wall, CAID
description: A close-up street photograph of a stickered wall packed with paste-ups: 'CAID', 'STAR CHARACTER', 'TOIZ', 'MORE STREET FOR ART', and a central white skull-faced Mr. Snowmann tag at the centre. Saturated reds, blues and yellows compete across the surface.
composition: all-over sticker collage on wall
central plane on cyan ground, axial drip columns
description: A cyan-and-grey ground hosts a top-down warplane drawing centered above a grid of black-and-white photographic fragments and a small bottle illustration. Concentric target rings cluster at the corners; vertical pink and yellow drips column down the middle.
title: Cyan Bombsight

composition: central black panel with disc-corner anchors
description: A central black panel hosts a maroon football and a chess king sketch, framed by iridescent compact discs in the corners. Pink and lavender drip columns fall through the centre; a base frieze of small CDs and printed perforation marks closes the bottom.
title: Black Box, Iridescent Discs

composition: wide horizontal squadron above target frieze
description: A wide horizontal squadron of top-down warplanes crosses the upper field on yellow vertical drips. Below, a saturated frieze of red-and-black bullseye targets and concentric circles runs along the base; a lower bomber drawing punctuates the lower right.
title: Squadron Above Targets

composition: framed yellow inset on light field with disc anchors
description: A central inset frames a top-down warplane drawing on a yellow ground, with photographic snapshots and red panels around the edges. Three gold compact discs anchor the upper field; below the inset, two iridescent discs and a chess piece sit on the white margin. Inscribed 'how to create' along the right edge.
title: Yellow Inset, How to Create

composition: speaker frieze above plane row, dark ground
description: On a black ground a row of stereo speakers and components stretches across the upper register; below, three top-down warplane line drawings advance with concentric target rings flanking. A small ladder element climbs the left side; saturated cobalt and turquoise accents punctuate the dark field.
title: Stereo Squadron

composition: central plane on white panel, disc-studded borders
description: Black borders studded with mounted compact discs run down both sides; the central white panel hosts a four-engine bomber line drawing with rivet-perforations descending below it. A maroon football and orange ribbon strip flank the lower edge; two gold discs sit at the base.
title: Bomber, Disc Frame
Disc Bouquet
description: A vertical wall assemblage on plastic-wrapped backing: a bouquet of iridescent compact discs at the upper centre over red and blue ribbon stripes, a central horizontal pair of gold discs framing a small floral motif, and a base frieze of red ribbons studded with circular tabs. A single suspended disc hangs at the bottom.
composition: vertical bouquet altar, ribbon base
diamond disc cluster on layered yellow ground
description: Variant of the XXIII series in yellow: four gold compact discs arrange diamond-formation across the centre over a layered field of warplane drawings, equipment fragments and red blocks. Black-and-white perforated borders frame the top and bottom; a pink scribbled column drops at lower left, with a target medallion at right.
title: XXIII Discs, Yellow

composition: axial vertical pair on dark ground with perforated borders
description: Companion to the XXIII series in magenta and black: a vertical pair of top-down warplane drawings hovers central, framed by black-and-white perforated borders and dripping pink columns. A small line-drawn elephant clings to the upper left; concentric target rings flank.
title: XXIII Discs, Magenta

composition: receding squadron above cassette base
description: Five top-down warplane silhouettes stack in receding scale on a white field, the upper plane in solid colour, the lower in line drawing. Below, three blue cassette tapes carry compact discs as reels along the base.
title: Squadron and Cassettes
You Call It God
description: A street paste-up of a black-stenciled creature holding a large white sign reading 'YOU CALL IT GOD WE CALL IT A PRANK' in red block letters. A small Mr. Snowmann tag with snowman icon sits at lower left; tag 'MEME' at right edge.
composition: central paste-up with text sign on cream wall
central tree photograph framed by yellow bands, planes above
description: Three line-drawn warplanes descend from the upper black panel toward a black-and-white photograph of a leafy tree at centre, its trunk cradling six gold compact discs. Yellow vertical bands frame the entire composition.
title: Tree of Discs
